about: The week the clocks go back (Sunday 2026-11-01: tests/dst.test.js has the rules), from the backup's week on. Episode 7 is the first one after daylight time ends: it airs at 8 PM EST (01:00 UTC), and the Drive-By changes a move at 7:55 PM EST (taken: a lock read at October's offset would have closed at 7 PM) and at 8:05 PM (refused). Episode 7's research then writes Episode 8's start with October's offset ("2026-11-11T20:00:00-04:00", as research once did: 3b42dca0), and the app must still have it at 8 PM EST; the Drive-By's moves at Episode 8's lock show it. Otherwise the realistic season: the swap at 7, the merge at 9, a double boot at 11, the finale at 13.
